def get_bar_state(seg):
    """Get the green and gray bar segments"""
    green_end = 19  # default: no green
    gray_start = 20  # default: gray starts at 20
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'N':  # light green
            b = n['boundary']
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cols) >= 19 and min(cols) <= 25:  # bar region
                green_end = max(cols)
        if n['color'] == 'G':  # dark gray
            b = n['boundary']
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cols) >= 20 and min(cols) <= 52:  # bar region
                gray_start = min(cols)
    return green_end, gray_start

# Press RIGHT 20 times and monitor the bar

for i in range(20):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_end, gray_start = get_bar_state(seg)
    green_width = green_end - 19  # green starts at col 20

    total = green_width + gray_width
    
    yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
    
    print(f"  After RIGHT {i+1}: green={green_width}, gray={gray_width}, birds={len(yellow_birds)}")
